answer: Each new identity must pay a non-transferable work fee tied to a single-use, short-lived challenge, so one proof mints exactly one key and cannot be replayed. A thousand socks then cost a thousand sequential mining rounds instead of one reused nonce. Older members also vouch for newcomers, and a whisper of a flag on a cluster of keys cuts its trust to an opal glint while honest, rounded copper coins keep their weight.
